item.title: EplayerX 1.2.15
item.description:
## 更新日志
- 修复 Emby 播放列表中的剧集详情跳转，保留对应的季数和集数，避免匹配到错误的节目。 - 改善杜比视界 Profile 7 转 Profile 8.1 播放及跳转后的画面兼容性。 - 改善播放恢复、音轨切换和跳转到未缓存位置时的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What's New
- Fixed episode navigation from Emby playlists, preserving season and episode information and avoiding incorrect show matches. - Improved Dolby Vision Profile 7 to Profile 8.1 playback compatibility, including playback after seeking. - Improved playback recovery, audio track switching, and seeking to uncached positions.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
